summary:
But soon you’re back at the wreckage of the old silk mill, and you help him over the wall. He’s perfectly capable of getting over it himself, but it’s a good excuse to take his gloved hand, to touch the nylon of his black jacket. You don’t let go of his hand as you lead him around the ruins, careful to not disturb anything, and down to the archives.
